race.description: Become A Brc Member Mdn Plate
race.comment: Open race to kick us off. EMPHATIQUE (8) has been well in the betting in all three runs this preparation and looks to be building up to a maiden victory. Placed around this circuit two back and where there's smoke there's fire. Should give backers a sight up on speed. SILENT ANSWER (10) is a former SA galloper having her first run for the new stable but showed ability when last in work. Tuned up for this with a recent trial and can run a big race while fresh. INDAMOUSE (3) has been just behind the placegetters at the past couple of outings and will be at peak fitness for this. Respect the Vandyke/Maloney combination. KONIGSTEIN (4) brings NSW formlines to the table and should be kept very safe. ST ANDREWS (7) next in line with the claim.
